{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Manuel Piar Hydroelectric Power Plant (Tocoma Dam) is under construction and it is the last hydroelectric development project in the Lower Caroní River Basin of Venezuela.","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The project includes the installation of 2320 MW MW to generate an annual average energy of 12,100 GWh .","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Ten Kaplan generator units, of 230 MW , manufactured by Argentinian company IMPSA, were predicted to begin operations between 2012 and 2014.","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The first generator was installed but not yet commissioned in April 2012.","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Behind scheduled, the dam began to impound its reservoir on 16 November 2015.","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" These units had the world record as of 2012 in power generation at nominal head for Kaplan turbines.","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" The diameter of the runner is 8.6 m and nominal head is 34.65 m with claimed output up to 232 MW .","title":"Tocoma Dam"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Isaiah Trunk (Polish: Izajasz Trunk ; 1905–1981) was a chief archivist of the Yiddish Scientific Institute YIVO in New York from Warsaw, and the leading historian on the Holocaust.","title":"Isaiah Trunk"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Trunk was an expert on Jewish history during the Nazi occupation of Poland.","title":"Isaiah Trunk"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" A scholar and author originally from Poland, he was the winner of a National Book Award in history for his monograph titled \"Judenrat: The Jewish Councils in Eastern Europe Under Nazi Occupation\" published in New York by Macmillan in 1972.","title":"Isaiah Trunk"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Annæus Schjødt was the prosecutor of which nominal head of Norway during the Nazi occupation?"}
